## Executive Summary & Background

Technical founder who spent 6+ years building and scaling a pharmaceutical company from the ground up, managing complete technology, business operations, and a 20+ member team to Rs.7.5+ Cr ($784K+ USD) in total revenue. Began building AI products part-time in 2024, stepped back from day-to-day operations in Feb 2025 to pursue full-time AI engineering while remaining a non-executive Director & Shareholder, and founded Zero Headache to build autonomous AI systems.

Specializes in building AI-native SaaS and Agentic SaaS (AaaS) products from scratch — multi-agent systems, automations, AI agents, MCP servers, RAG with vector search, semantic search, AI IDEs and coding agents, payment gateway integrations, and production full-stack engineering with modern web frameworks.

Recipient of "The Founding 500" recognition by Hyperagent (by Airtable) in June 2026 ($20,000 in platform credits).

- **AI IDEs and coding agents:** Google Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Google AI Studio, OpenCode, Context engineering (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules), custom subagents, custom skills, test-driven agent loops, spec-driven development.
- **AI automation & integrations:** Trigger.dev, Inngest, Upstash Redis, QStash, n8n, Zapier, Webhooks, REST APIs, JSON-RPC 2.0, Resend, Postmark, SendGrid, Brevo, AWS SES, Twilio, Sent.dm, Vapi, Murf AI, ElevenLabs, Deepgram, Composio, Zernio, Cal.com API, GitHub API, Notion API, PostHog, Langfuse, Sentry.

- **Full-stack engineering:** PostgreSQL, Supabase, pgvector, Row-Level Security (RLS), Prisma 7, Drizzle ORM, SQLite, Node.js, WebAuthn, Clerk Auth, Supabase Auth, HMAC token impersonation, CSRF protection, rate limiting, PII redaction.
- **Payment gateways integrations:** Stripe, Dodo Payments, Polar, Lemon Squeezy, Creem, Webhook signature verification, idempotent event processing, subscription lifecycles.

## Detailed Project Case Studies

### 1. Portfolio OS
- **Category:** Interactive Desktop Portfolio & Web System (Open-sourced)
- **URL:** https://scalewithalap.com/projects/portfolio-os | GitHub: https://github.com/scalewithalap/portfolio-os
- **Codebase:** React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 + Zustand + Immer + Web Audio API
- **Overview:** Built a custom web window manager recreating macOS and iOS desktop interfaces, supporting window dragging, resizing, edge and quadrant snapping, z-index focus management, and minimize/restore animations across 39 components. Centralized state across 30+ fields using Zustand and Immer, lazy-loaded 13 apps with React.lazy and Suspense, and implemented 60 FPS dock animations using requestAnimationFrame and GPU-accelerated transforms.
- **Key Metrics:** 39 Components, 30+ State Fields, 13 Lazy Apps, 60 FPS GPU-Accelerated Dock.

### 2. Vibe44 Marketing Site & MCP Server
- **Category:** Next.js Starter Kit & Model Context Protocol
- **URL:** https://vibe44.com
- **Overview:** Implemented a serverless Model Context Protocol (MCP) server from scratch using JSON-RPC 2.0, providing 6 tools, 4 resource templates, IP-based rate limiting, and /llms.txt endpoints for AI agent and RAG ingestion. Built idempotent Creem payment webhook handlers to automate post-purchase fulfillment, triggering GitHub repo invites, single-use Cal.com booking links, transactional Resend emails, and parallel Notion database syncs.
- **Key Metrics:** 6 MCP Tools, 4 Resource Templates, Idempotent Webhook Engine, /llms.txt RAG Ingestion.

### 3. Vibe44 (Next.js AI SaaS Starter Kit Demo)
- **Category:** Next.js 16 AI SaaS Starter Kit Engine
- **URL:** https://demo.vibe44.com
- **Overview:** Developed a Next.js 16 AI SaaS codebase (~165k lines across 687 files) using a Universal Adapter Pattern to support streaming, structured output, and runtime model switching across 4 LLM providers with a PII-redacting RAG pipeline. Engineered backend infrastructure with a 32-table PostgreSQL schema using Row-Level Security, integrating 5 payment gateways, 9 analytics providers, 4 fallback email services, WebAuthn, QStash/Trigger.dev background jobs, and 900+ unit and Playwright E2E tests.
- **Key Metrics:** ~165,000 Lines of Code, 687 Source Files, 900+ Unit and E2E Tests, 32 Postgres Tables with RLS.

### 4. OpenUI
- **Category:** Open Source Local-First UI Generator
- **URL:** https://github.com/scalewithalap/openui
- **Overview:** Built an open-source, local-first UI design tool using Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, SQLite, Prisma 7, and the Vercel AI SDK, enabling offline UI generation across 4 AI providers without requiring accounts, subscriptions, or cloud storage.

### 5. Zero Headache Marketing Site
- **Category:** AI Front Desk Marketing Engine
- **URL:** https://zeroheadache.co
- **Overview:** Built and launched a Next.js 16 and React 19 marketing site with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and Lenis, featuring an interactive ROI calculator, product coverage for 12 channels, 35+ CRM integrations, and structured JSON-LD schemas. Configured strict CSP, HSTS, clickjacking, and cross-origin security headers while optimizing accessibility and rendering performance through semantic HTML, accessible form controls, and responsive SVGs.

### 6. Zero Headache Platform
- **Category:** AI Front Desk & Multi-Tenant Agent Platform
- **URL:** https://app.zeroheadache.co
- **Overview:** Building from scratch a Next.js 16 platform that runs one sandboxed AI Agent per client with persistent memory and self-refining communication skills; OpenRouter provides multi-model routing and automatic failover. Connects channels and tools through MCP, with per-client Supabase RLS, Trigger.dev pipelines, PostHog/Langfuse observability, Dodo billing, and a LangChain operations orchestrator that requests permission before difficult actions.

### 7. Make Me Sound
- **Category:** AI Communication Copilot
- **URL:** https://makemesound.xyz
- **Overview:** Building a parallel multi-stream engine that converts drafts into 105 tone variations with sub-second streaming; expanding across web, desktop, browser, and mobile clients. Employs Next.js 16, OpenRouter, Supabase RLS, Upstash Redis rate limiting, Lemonsqueezy subscription billing, Tauri v2 desktop floating toolboxes, and WXT browser extensions.

### 8. Freecom AI
- **Category:** Open-Source AI-Powered eCommerce Platform
- **URL:** https://github.com/scalewithalap/freecom-ai
- **Overview:** Building an open-source digital-download commerce platform with a self-hosted Store Manager Agent and a cloud agent swarm for SEO, content, marketing, analytics, and support with human approval controls. Uses Next.js 16, Supabase PostgreSQL, Trigger.dev background workers, Composio.dev, Zernio social API, and Human-in-the-Loop approval controls.

### 9. Soothly AI
- **Category:** Autonomous 8-Agent Revenue Platform
- **URL:** https://github.com/scalewithalap/soothly-ai
- **Overview:** Building an autonomous revenue operations platform with an 8-agent ecosystem (Lead Gen, SEO, Partnership, Proposal, Competitor Intel, Revenue Recovery, Onboarding, and Customer Success) orchestrated by a central Superagent manager. Runs durable workflow functions with Inngest step execution, stores embeddings in Supabase pgvector with Row-Level Security, and features 3-tier autonomy settings (manual, smart, auto).

2. **Zero Headache (AI-native Front Desk Service)** — *Co-founder & CEO* (July 2026 – Present)
